direct-answer.description: Use for simple answers or session continuation when no larger workflow package is needed.
direct-answer.expected_output: A concise answer or session update grounded in the broker event and bounded session context.
verification: cd gateway && npm run smoke:session-history
cd gateway && npm run smoke:message-broker

coding.description: Use for implementation, bug fixing, deployment, repo workflow, and verification requests.
coding.expected_output: A narrow implementation unit with focused verification, a Conventional Commit, and deploy attempt or recorded blocker.
verification: cd gateway && npm run check
bash scripts/deploy.sh auto

qa.description: Use for testing, validation, smoke checks, regressions, and runtime QA requests.
qa.expected_output: A pass/fail verification report with commands, observed behavior, and blockers.
verification: cd gateway && npm run check
cd browser_extension && npm run verify && npm run smoke
cd android_app && ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ./gradlew assembleDebug

landscape-research.description: Use for broad research, comparison, online search, prior art, market, and optimal-path questions.
landscape-research.expected_output: A sourced research report, comparison, recommendation, and implementation implications.
verification: record sources and search queries in reference/scratch/landscape-research
link findings back to an OpenSpec change or tracked ticket

design.description: Use for frontend, visual design, interaction model, and UX QA requests.
design.expected_output: A working UI change verified with screenshots or text/layout checks.
verification: run the target surface verify command
capture before/after screenshots when a browser or app surface changes

writing.description: Use for writing, editing, copy, posts, emails, docs, and voice/style work.
writing.expected_output: A concise draft or critique that preserves the user's intent and stores any durable product decision in repo files.
verification: check edited docs render/read correctly
do not hand-edit generated CHANGELOG.md

security.description: Use for explicit security audits, threat reviews, and vulnerability assessment. This principal reports only and never repairs its own findings.
constraints: Audit only; do not edit product code or repair findings in this run.
Bind every finding to the exact candidate and reproducible evidence.
Require a separate repair run and a different independent re-verification run before acceptance.
security.repair_handoff: Create bounded repair contracts only. A separate principal implements accepted fixes and a different verifier re-runs the original probes against the repaired candidate.
security.expected_output: A severity-ranked, deduplicated security audit with exact candidate identity, reproducible evidence, affected boundary, and bounded repair contracts.
verification: run the narrowest read-only security checks for the exact candidate
record PASS or BLOCK without modifying the candidate

simplification.description: Use for deslop, line-count reduction, behavior-preserving rearchitecture, and code-quality leveling.
constraints: Preserve externally observable behavior, public contracts, and trust boundaries.
Keep one cleanup unit tied to before/after measurements and focused regression checks.
May edit, test, and commit one behavior-preserving candidate in its isolated branch/worktree only.
Do not mix feature work, product-policy changes, or broad rewrites into the cleanup.
Do not merge, deploy, promote, publish, push master, or modify active deployment refs or services from this run.
Do not weaken, delete, skip, or bypass checks, acceptance predicates, authority boundaries, or verification to reduce code.
simplification.repair_handoff: Hand the committed candidate and unchanged acceptance checks to a separate independent verifier. Integration, merge, push, deployment, and promotion remain coordinator-owned after that verifier passes.
simplification.expected_output: A narrow behavior-preserving cleanup with before/after line or complexity evidence, focused regression proof, and a Conventional Commit.
verification: run focused behavior-preservation tests
run the touched surface verification gate
record before/after line or complexity evidence

fuzzing.description: Use for fuzzing and adversarial application testing against one exact isolated candidate. This principal produces evidence and repair handoffs, not fixes.
constraints: Run only in an isolated workspace against one exact candidate identity.
Minimize and deduplicate failures before reporting them.
Do not repair findings or launch repair fanout in this run.
fuzzing.repair_handoff: For each unique reproduced failure, emit one bounded repair contract naming candidate, seed/input, minimized reproducer, allowed scope, and exact re-verification check.
fuzzing.expected_output: Exact-candidate fuzz evidence with corpus/seed identity, minimized and deduplicated findings, and bounded repair handoffs.
verification: replay every minimized finding against the exact candidate
prove duplicates collapse to one finding identity
record unreproduced results as inconclusive rather than defects
